# Tunir Saha

> Full stack developer with 12+ years of experience, based in Bengaluru, India.
> Builds the frontend, the API behind it, and the cloud infrastructure both run on.
> Most recently Lead Engineer at FICO (Oct 2024 - Oct 2026).

Last updated: 2026-11-02

## Summary

Tunir Saha is a full stack software developer and engineering lead who has shipped
production web, mobile and cloud applications since 2014 at FICO, IBM, Accenture,
Blue Space Labs, Bridgera and Cognizant. He works end to end: Angular and React on
the frontend, Node.js, Python and PHP on the backend, PostgreSQL/MySQL/MongoDB for
data, and AWS, Azure or GCP underneath. He also leads teams — sprint planning, code
review, architecture decisions and mentoring — which makes him an all-round hire
rather than a single-layer specialist.

## Technical skills

- **Frontend:** Angular (2 through 20), React (16 through 19), Next.js, TypeScript,
  JavaScript ES6+, RxJS, NgRx, NgXs, Redux/Thunk, Zustand, TanStack Query, Module Federation,
  micro-frontends, PrimeNG, Ionic, Tailwind, HTML5, CSS3, SCSS, WCAG AA
- **Backend:** Node.js, Express, Python, FastAPI, PHP (core and 7.x), REST APIs,
  Socket.IO, Kafka, MQTT, real-time and event-driven services
- **Data:** PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB
- **Cloud & DevOps:** AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, GitHub Actions, Heroku
- **Testing:** Jest, React Testing Library, Jasmine, Karma, Playwright, unit and end-to-end coverage
- **Other:** XGBoost, IoT telemetry, AI-assisted development (Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot)
- **Tools:** GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket,
  Jira, Trello, ClickUp

## Experience

- **FICO — Lead Engineer** (Oct 2024 – Oct 2026, Bengaluru). Architected a
  feature-authoring platform that lets financial institutions map their systems to
  FICO systems, built as Microfrontends with Angular 20, TypeScript and Module
  Federation on AWS. Node.js Backend-for-Frontend API layers. Jest and Playwright
  testing. Won the worldwide AWS Cost Optimization Hackathon with an XGBoost model
  that identified 17,000 savings parameters worth $4M a year.
- **IBM — Senior System Analyst** (Jan 2022 – Oct 2024, Bengaluru). Microfrontend
  logistics platform with Module Federation and Angular 14. Reusable React 18 UI
  component library that cut development time 40%. Node.js REST services over
  PostgreSQL and MongoDB on AWS and Azure. Playwright end-to-end tests.
- **Accenture — Application Development Specialist / Team Lead** (Apr 2021 –
  Jan 2022, Bengaluru). Distributed enterprise applications with Angular 12,
  React 17, Node.js, PostgreSQL and MongoDB on AWS and GCP for a global technology
  client. Improved performance 30% (LCP and load time). Led 6 developers.
- **Blue Space Labs — Associate Technical Lead** (May 2020 – Apr 2021, remote).
  Built the Bluwyre MVP with React 16 and Node.js: a Kafka-backed omnichannel
  messaging platform over WhatsApp, Viber and Telegram. Migrated PHP/MySQL to
  Node.js APIs, Ionic mobile apps, AWS. Led 15 developers across 2 teams.
- **Bridgera — Senior Software Engineer** (Jan 2020 – May 2020, Kolkata).
  Real-time event-driven healthcare IoT dashboards with Angular 8, Node.js,
  MongoDB, MySQL, Socket.IO and an EMQX MQTT broker on AWS.
- **Cognizant — Associate** (Oct 2014 – Jan 2020, Kolkata). B2B bullion trading
  platform (React 16, Node.js, PostgreSQL), IoT telematics dashboard (Angular 6),
  distributed document processing (Angular 4, AWS SQS), a no-code CMS/LMS,
  Liferay and Salesforce extensions, and WCAG AA accessibility for a global airline.

## Side projects (all live)

- [BillMate](https://tunirsaha.com/projects/billmate/) — GST-compliant invoicing
  for Indian businesses. Angular 20, PHP, MySQL.
- [Between](https://tunirsaha.com/projects/between/) — finds the fair midpoint
  between two people and the places around it. JavaScript, Leaflet,
  OpenStreetMap, offline-capable PWA.
- [Buttons](https://tunirsaha.com/projects/buttons/) — one-tap logging for
  anything repeated: baby feeds, naps and nappies, or water, gym sets and office
  hours. Timestamps every tap and builds daily, weekly, monthly and yearly
  totals; share code lets two people log to the same buttons. JavaScript, PHP,
  IndexedDB, offline-first PWA with CSV export.
- [SocietyKit](https://societykit.in/) — housing society management platform:
  admin dashboard for billing and records, plus resident and gate-security
  mobile apps. Angular, Node.js, Ionic.
